title: Propane Education and Research Enhancement Act of 2014
official_summary:
(This measure has not been amended since it was introduced. The summary of that version is repeated here.)

Propane Education and Research Enhancement Act of 2014 - Amends the Propane Education and Research Act of 1996 to direct the Propane Education and Research Council to develop for propane distributors and consumers training programs on strategies to mitigate negative effects of future propane price spikes.

Directs the Secretary of Commerce to use the refiner price to end users of consumer grade propane as published by the Energy Information Administration when preparing the annual analysis of changes in the price of propane relative to other energy sources.

summary.headline: A 2014 law directs a propane research council to create training on handling future propane price spikes and changes how a Commerce Department price report measures propane costs.
summary.what_it_does: The law amends the Propane Education and Research Act of 1996. It directs the Propane Education and Research Council to develop training programs on strategies for reducing the negative effects of future propane price spikes. It also tells the Commerce Secretary to use the refiner price to end users of consumer-grade propane, as published by the Energy Information Administration, when preparing the annual analysis of propane prices compared with other energy sources.

who_it_affects.how: They are the audience for the council's new training programs on handling future propane price spikes.
They are the other audience for the council's training programs, which cover strategies for dealing with price spikes.
It must develop the training programs the law describes.
Its annual propane price analysis must use the refiner price to end users of consumer-grade propane as its data source.

summary.when_it_takes_effect: Enacted December 18, 2014; the summary does not list a separate effective date.
